verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a note-taking SaaS that ships a public REST API, so the story applies. However, the documented API surface is only request/response endpoints (graphs, links, daily-notes, notes, users/me), with no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The Zapier integration is a third-party connector, not a first-party webhook capability, so it earns no credit.
